room_description: A dark, rundown brick room with exposed pipes, an old AC unit on the wall, wooden crates on the left, a piece of old electronic equipment on the ground, and a sealed wooden door.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the room and introduction.
Zooming in on the AC unit to collect a screwdriver.
Picking up the empty monitor casing from the debris.
Inspecting the '1P' block on the ground.
Removing the '1P' cover to reveal a remote control.
Inspecting the rusty '2P' panel on the brick wall.
Connecting the power cord to the monitor casing.
Using the remote to turn on the monitor, revealing a clue with four dials.
Opening the '2P' panel to reveal four physical dials.
Adjusting the dials to match the pattern shown on the monitor.

solution_steps: Find the screwdriver stuck in the AC unit.
Pick up the empty monitor casing from the pile of wood on the ground.
Locate the dark grey block marked '1P' on the ground.
Place the monitor casing back down.
Plug the loose power cord into the monitor.
Use the remote control to turn it on and observe the dial orientation clue.
puzzles.reward: Visual clue (Dial orientations: top-left, bottom-left, top-right, bottom-right)

solution_steps: Use the screwdriver to remove the screws on the rusty '2P' panel.
Adjust the four dials to match the visual clue from the monitor.

final_action: The player successfully aligns the 4 dials behind the '2P' panel, causing the secret door hidden in the wall behind the wooden crates to swing open, allowing escape.
